Project · In flight

Elo System

Elo ratings for fantasy leagues, pulled straight from Fantrax and Sleeper. Seasonal and all-time.

  • Python
  • PostgreSQL
  • pandas
  • Fantrax API
  • Sleeper API
View on GitHub →

This is the final iteration of an R script I wrote years ago to manually calculate our league's Elo ratings. Now a fully fleshed out Python package, you can connect it to your fantasy league and calculate ratings based on completed matchups. If your league is a dynasty league you can get both the seasonal and all time ratings. You can adjust the K factor or off-season equilibrium rate to fit your league as needed.

What it supports

Platforms — Fantrax, Sleeper

Leagues — NBA, NFL

Formats — Categories, Points

If you have any feature requests, please feel free to email me here.
